feature_causality: All proposal features are registered completed-bar shared-state or causal OHLCV fields. The prior8 range uses only shifted historical highs/lows; the current candle fields are available after close.
timestamp_and_purge: Runner uses source bars strictly before 2026-10-01 for selection, labels only matured same-segment 3/5/10/20-bar outcomes under both fills, and 60-minute training purges.
gap_and_concentration_sensitivity: Deferred: registered selection stage does not replay positions or score trade profit; any eventual global winner must pass the one-time holdout gap/occupancy and concentration audit.
limitations: Scores from overlapping minute opportunities are descriptive, not independent-trade significance tests.
Hindsight best action/exit depends on future prices and cannot be a live chart input.
Source contract, roll and timestamp convention remain unverified.
No strategy profitability is established by this family.
